facts.fact_text: At the time of the events giving rise to the present application, the applicant was a student at the Philosophy Department of the Faculty of Arts and Science at Dicle University.
On 28 March 2006 at around 7 a.m., the remains of the four PKK militants were taken to a mosque where around 1,500–2,000 people had gathered.
The crowd at the mosque on 28 March 2006 blocked traffic as they carried the coffins of the four PKK militants.
The crowd at the mosque on 28 March 2006 chanted separatist, hostile slogans in Turkish and Kurdish in support of the PKK and Abdullah Öcalan, the leader of the PKK.
The crowd at the mosque on 28 March 2006 waved PKK posters and banners.
The crowd on 28 March 2006 walked to a cemetery for the burial of the four deceased PKK militants.
On 9 March 2007 the applicant was arrested.
On 10 March 2007 the applicant was questioned at the anti-terror branch of the Diyarbakır police headquarters.
During questioning on 10 March 2007 at the anti-terror branch of the Diyarbakır police headquarters, the applicant denied taking part in the demonstration of 5 March 2007 at Dicle University.
During questioning on 10 March 2007 at the anti-terror branch of the Diyarbakır police headquarters, the applicant denied taking part in the funeral of 28 March 2006 and the subsequent events.
On 10 March 2007 the applicant made a statement to the Diyarbakır public prosecutor.
The applicant was shown photographs taken of him on 28 March 2006 during the funeral of the PKK militants.
The applicant was shown photographs taken of him on 5 March 2007 during the demonstration at Dicle University.
The applicant was brought before a judge of the Diyarbakır Assize Court on 10 March 2007.

The judge of the Diyarbakır Assize Court remanded the applicant in custody on the basis of a strong suspicion that he had committed the offence of disseminating propaganda in support of a terrorist organisation or its purposes.
At the end of the first hearing on 19 June 2007, the Diyarbakır Assize Court ordered the applicant's continued detention on remand.

On 30 November 2007, at the end of the fourth hearing, the Diyarbakır Assize Court convicted the applicant of membership of an illegal organisation, the PKK, pursuant to Article 314 § 2 of the Criminal Code (Law no. 5237), on the basis of Articles 220 § 6 and 314 § 3 of the same Code.
The Diyarbakır Assize Court sentenced the applicant to six years and three months' imprisonment for membership of an illegal organisation, the PKK.
The Diyarbakır Assize Court convicted the applicant of two counts of disseminating propaganda in support of the PKK under section 7(2) of Law no. 3713.

The Diyarbakır Assize Court sentenced the applicant to a total of one year and eight months' imprisonment for two counts of disseminating propaganda in support of the PKK under section 7(2) of Law no. 3713.
The applicant was charged with disseminating propaganda in support of the PKK under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713).
The applicant was charged with membership of an illegal organisation under Article 314 § 2 of the Criminal Code (Law no. 5237), on the basis of Articles 220 § 6 and 314 § 3 of the same Code.

At the material time, Article 220 § 6 of the Criminal Code (Law no. 5237) provided that anyone who commits a crime on behalf of an illegal organisation, even if they are not a member of that organisation, shall also be punished for being a member of the organisation.

At the material time, Article 220 § 8 of the Criminal Code (Law no. 5237) provided that anyone who spreads propaganda for the organisation or its objectives shall be punished by imprisonment of between one and three years, and if the said crime is committed through the media and press the sentence shall be increased by one half.

At the material time, section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713) provided that any person who disseminates propaganda in support of a terrorist organisation shall be liable to a term of imprisonment of between one and five years.
